Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to follow the Planner’s explicit instruction to open the specified sources (Wikipedia and IMDb) for both films and extract the production countries. Instead, it performed another generic search focused only on Passer l’hiver and then repeatedly reloaded the same Passer l’hiver Wikipedia page, never opening In My Skin’s sources or IMDb for either film. This deviation led to an incomplete workflow and no definitive answer to whether both films originated from the same country.
